construct: Inherited defects in motile-cilia structure, function, or biogenesis impair mucociliary clearance. Many affected individuals have dynein-arm or other axonemal defects, causing chronic sinopulmonary disease; abnormal embryonic nodal cilia can randomize left-right patterning, and flagellar dysfunction can impair fertility.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Lifelong wet cough, chronic otitis/nasal disease, bronchiectasis, situs inversus, and very low nasal nitric oxide identify primary ciliary dyskinesia from motile-cilia dysfunction.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Cystic fibrosis and immunodeficiency can cause bronchiectasis, but they do not explain congenital laterality abnormalities from nodal-cilia dysfunction; alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and ABPA also fail the age and congenital-phenotype fit.
